category_title: Typically developing student who seeks attention and connects tasks to personal life
minimal_context: The student is participating in a turn-and-talk activity with a partner during an interactive read-aloud of 'Rocket Writes a Story' to practice new vocabulary words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's do our turn and talk for 'Rocket Writes a Story'. Sidney, you can share your example for the word 'declared' first.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: My mom declared I would get homework done so that I could watch SpongeBob and play with the dog.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. Now let's talk about the next word. This time, your partner will share their example first.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Waits as her peer responds before her) I am willing to express my thoughts now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead, what is your example?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Repeats her peer's response) I'll just say the same thing my partner said.
